answer: The three words are derived from a 189 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. Because the nadir nonce is published only after close, the ember audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate mirror derivation per key. That is 11 dollars per alias.
